scripts.dev: npm run build -w @todo/contracts && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w @todo/api" "npm run dev -w @todo/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @todo/contracts && npm run build -w @todo/api && npm run build -w @todo/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @todo/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @todo/contracts && npm run test -w @todo/api
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
